# DB Console — Mobile Delta Plan

The Awtsmoos can hold dangerous depth inside a narrow, deliberate gate;
Awtsmoos.com keeps data power folded, touchable, contained, and never visually late.

## Proven containment

A readiness-aware runtime probe opened all four operation panels simultaneously and stress-filled the response area with a long unbroken payload.

At desktop 1440×900, phone 390×844, and short phone 320×568:
- document horizontal overflow remained 0;
- no visible summary, input, textarea, or submit button crossed a side edge;
- no visible interactive control measured below 30px;
- phone inputs remained 44px high and submit buttons 46px high;
- mobile summaries measured 64px high;
- long response text remained width-contained: `scrollWidth === clientWidth` at 728px, 326px, and 256px;
- browser runtime exception capture was empty;
- existing contract suite passed 7/7.

The probe forced all cards open after load, so its `initiallyOpen` array is not valid initial-state evidence. The source contract test independently proves Read is the only default-open operation.

## Only proven production gap

`styles/operations.css` gives submit buttons a transform/filter transition and `button:hover`, but no `button:active`. This violates the current interaction contract and leaves touch press feedback incomplete.

The operation `<summary>` elements are already 50–64px touch targets and structurally contained, but they are expandable controls with no hover/active transition feedback. Completing their states improves consistency without changing layout.

## Exact rewrite

- Create `styles/operation-cards.css` for grid, card shell, disclosure summary, danger-card border, mobile disclosure stacking, hover/active/focus, and reduced motion.
- Rewrite `styles/operations.css` completely to import `operation-cards.css` and own form/input/textarea/button/danger-button behavior only.
- Scope hover effects under `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
- Add `button:active:not(:disabled)` pressed feedback.
- Keep existing global `:focus-visible` foundation and add card-specific focus shape only where useful.
- Preserve every size, field geometry, mutation disclosure, result behavior, and API contract.

## Verification

Run line-count/long-line/diff gates, 7 contract tests, and remeasure 390×844 + 320×568 with all cards open. No broader DB Console rewrite is justified unless this recheck uncovers a regression.
